title: gatewatch: constitution changed without explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit 03ab56729b96eb4091c97513de8bcdaeb5e11fb4 (2026-09-30) adds docs/CONSTITUTION.md, lines 1-142. Article IX requires changes to the constitution to receive explicit human review and forbids riding an auto-merged PR. The commit metadata shows a normal commit by Roger Navelsaker, but the repository history contains no explicit human sign-off or tracker reference for the required review. Record as a mandate-protection finding.

title: gatewatch: audit trigger configuration changed without explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit 87e4f8a4b6a686a77265b18c703758141eec45f2 adds .warren/triggers.yaml, lines 1-47, including gatewatch/ratchetwatch/tastewatch audit entries. Article IX requires changes to .warren/triggers.yaml audit entries to receive explicit human review and forbids riding an auto-merged PR. The commit metadata/history contains no explicit human sign-off or tracker reference for that required review. Record as a mandate-protection finding.

title: gatewatch: governance title claims workflow changes absent from diff
description: Evidence: commit 03ab56729b96eb4091c97513de8bcdaeb5e11fb4, subject 'chore(governance): standardize CONSTITUTION.md and automated workflows'; git show --stat reports only docs/CONSTITUTION.md (142 insertions), with no workflow file changed. Article I requires commit/PR titles and descriptions to describe their diff truthfully. The subject claims automated-workflow standardization that is not present as a workflow-file change; the only workflow-related material is prose inside the newly added constitution.
